frontmatter.name: consultant-onboard
frontmatter.description: Entry point for the Consultant framework. Use to start a project, open a new change, or continue an existing change. Also use when the user says "consultant onboard" or runs /consultant-onboard.

frontmatter.name: consultant-archive
frontmatter.description: Archives a Consultant change. Applies the change's SPEC delta and records its ADR decisions in ProjectDocs/project.md, then moves the change folder to archive. Use when the user asks to archive a change.

frontmatter.name: consultant-de-bono
frontmatter.description: De Bono six thinking hats tool for the Consultant framework. Reviews a proposal from six fixed viewpoints, one at a time. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for six hats, De Bono, or structured parallel thinking.

frontmatter.name: consultant-document
frontmatter.description: Creates the PRD, ADR, or SPEC document for a Consultant change. Takes one argument, type, which is prd, adr, or spec. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for a PRD, an ADR, or a spec for a change.

frontmatter.name: consultant-fmea
frontmatter.description: FMEA (failure mode and effects analysis) tool for the Consultant framework. Turns problems from Ishikawa, Red Team, and Pre-Mortem into scored failure modes with a risk priority number. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for FMEA or risk scoring.

frontmatter.name: consultant-ishikawa
frontmatter.description: Ishikawa (fishbone) root cause analysis tool for the Consultant framework. Groups possible causes of a problem into categories and tests candidate root causes. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for fishbone, Ishikawa, or root cause analysis.

frontmatter.name: consultant-mece
frontmatter.description: MECE analysis tool for the Consultant framework. Splits a topic into branches that do not overlap and cover everything. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for MECE, mutually exclusive collectively exhaustive, or structured decomposition.

frontmatter.name: consultant-premortem
frontmatter.description: Pre-mortem tool for the Consultant framework. Assumes the project has already failed and writes plausible failure stories with warning signs and mitigations. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for a pre-mortem or failure analysis before work starts.

frontmatter.name: consultant-red-team
frontmatter.description: Red team tool for the Consultant framework. Attacks the assumptions of a plan and tests whether they hold. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for red teaming, assumption testing, or a devil's advocate review.

frontmatter.name: consultant-report
frontmatter.description: Creates the final consolidated report for a Consultant change. Combines all tool outputs and documents into one report. Use when the user asks for the final report, or from consultant-onboard when all tools and documents are done.

frontmatter.name: consultant-wardley
frontmatter.description: Wardley mapping tool for the Consultant framework. Places user needs and components on an evolution axis and proposes strategic moves. Use from consultant-onboard or when the user asks for Wardley mapping, value chain, or build versus buy analysis.
